Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFAwsKmsConfig

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFAwsKmsConfig
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public final class CPDFAwsKmsConfig extends Object implements Cloneable
Configuration for synchronous AWS KMS operations through CPDFAwsKmsSigner.

Set an HTTPS endpoint, region, key identifier and explicit credentials before submitting an operation. The SDK does not discover or refresh credentials and does not depend on the Java AWS SDK. The supported signing configuration is RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 with SHA-256; PDF signing requires an RSA key of at least 2048 bits. Session tokens are currently unsupported.

Defaults use empty connection/credential fields, algorithm RSASSA_PKCS1_V1_5_SHA_256, common name KMS Signer, and no self-signed certificate fallback. Setters normalize null strings to empty strings and return this instance. Operations copy the configuration before use; do not mutate it concurrently with submitting an operation.

  • Method Details

    • setEndpoint

      public CPDFAwsKmsConfig setEndpoint(String endpoint)
      Sets the KMS HTTPS endpoint.

      The endpoint must have a host and no explicit port, credentials, query or fragment. Its path must be empty or /, for example https://kms.us-east-1.amazonaws.com. Invalid endpoints are rejected when an operation is submitted.

      Parameters:
      endpoint - the endpoint URL; null clears the setting
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration

    • setRegion

      Parameters:

      Returns:
      this for chained configuration

    • setCredentials

      public CPDFAwsKmsConfig setCredentials(String accessKeyId, String secretAccessKey, String sessionToken)
      Sets the explicit credentials used for AWS Signature Version 4 authentication.

      Access key ID and secret access key are required. A nonempty session token causes operations to return sdk.kms.session_token_unsupported; temporary STS credentials are not supported by this binding. Credentials are retained in this configuration and must not be logged.

      Parameters:
      accessKeyId - the AWS access key ID; null becomes empty
      secretAccessKey - the AWS secret access key; null becomes empty
      sessionToken - null or empty; nonempty tokens are currently unsupported
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration

    • setSigningAlgorithm

      public CPDFAwsKmsConfig setSigningAlgorithm(String signingAlgorithm)
      Sets the KMS signing algorithm.

      Only RSASSA_PKCS1_V1_5_SHA_256 is supported. Other values are rejected with sdk.kms.algorithm_unsupported when an operation is submitted.

      Parameters:
      signingAlgorithm - the algorithm name; default is RSASSA_PKCS1_V1_5_SHA_256
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration

    • setAllowSelfSignedCertificateFallback

      public CPDFAwsKmsConfig setAllowSelfSignedCertificateFallback(boolean allowFallback)
      Controls whether signing may create a self-signed certificate when no signer certificate is supplied.

      This is disabled by default. A fallback certificate does not establish trust in a PDF viewer; configure the appropriate trust anchors when validating it.

      Parameters:
      allowFallback - true to permit fallback; false to require a supplied signer certificate
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration

    • setCertificate

      public CPDFAwsKmsConfig setCertificate(byte[] signer, byte[][] chain)
      Sets the X.509 signing certificate and accompanying certificate chain.

      PDF signing checks that the signer's public key matches the configured KMS key and that each supplied certificate is complete DER. Supplying a chain does not make it trusted; configure validation trust anchors separately. Public-key and CSR operations do not require a signer certificate. All supplied arrays are copied.

      Parameters:
      signer - the signer certificate in DER format, not PEM; null clears it
      chain - issuer certificates in DER format; null means no additional certificates
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration
